host_suspension.source: Read-only pmset -g log captured after regression wall-clock gap
host_suspension.coverage: Selected events, not an exhaustive sleep log. Repeated maintenance and sleep-service cycles continued overnight between the first clamshell sleep and the final full wake.
host_suspension.limitation: The run had a process-scoped idle-sleep inhibitor, which cannot prevent clamshell or every forced suspension. Timing-sensitive failures require individual inspection; the sleep does not prove every observed failure is environmental.
